decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on tightly linked to the firm's web-mapping base and already seeing rapid releases, it is a low-cost option worth keeping open while demand becomes clearer.
This plugin fits the core offer and is probably inexpensive to maintain, so despite limited market evidence so far the firm would likely keep it until uncertainty resolves further.
Its homepage visibility and clearly stated mobile usability benefit suggest promising strategic relevance, making continued market presence the sensible option.
Although a GIS solution platform is more resource-intensive than a small plugin, it is close to the firm's strategic direction and still too early to abandon before its option value is tested.
Mobile field data capture is adjacent to the firm's customer needs and merits being kept on the market because prospects are still uncertain but potentially valuable.
A search extension for web map apps is a close-to-core, modular software option whose likely low carrying cost supports keeping it rather than dropping it early.
